test_title: PYST 13: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven doctors, Ankit, Bhuvana, Chandan, Dinakar, Tarak, Fernanda and George, with different specialisations, are sitting in a straight line facing the north, but not necessarily in the same order. There is only one doctor between Fernanda and Chandan. Tarak is sitting between Ankit and Dinakar. There are only two doctors between Tarak and George. Fernanda is sitting on the immediate left of Ankit, who is sitting in the middle of the row.

Who among the following is sitting on the immediate right of Dinakar?
solution:
**Logic: **There are seven doctors sitting in a row facing towards the north. We have to make their sitting arrangement as per the given conditions.

Ankit is sitting in the middle of the row. Fernanda is sitting immediately left of Ankit. Also, Tarak is sitting between Ankit and Dinkar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7c61e9e49bf575ec5a39aa239c706dd5ad0586d682cc86a7c0872ec21fd4855.png] 

Also, there is one person between Fernanda and Chandan. There are two doctors between Tarak and George.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdd6828713680a82f8ee8db0ee7f18e03673f87c051554f30d1661b2b3010f2e.png] 

Now, only one place is remaining in which Bhuvana will sit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddb9f669ca46b9c4dd5d2b2a2c31dc7cb7d5e2031419e9d3c91bbdf9838fc1f1.png] 

Now, as it can be seen that Bhuvna is sitting immediate right of Dinakar.

Hence, the correct answer should be **"Bhuvana".**
